## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes wire protocol / API)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Test / tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest tests/ -q` passes locally (no new failures, no new errors)
- [ ] New behavior has new tests
- [ ] Existing tests updated if behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the next-version heading
- [ ] No secrets, real IPs, real hostnames, or passphrases added to the diff
- [ ] Docstrings / comments added for non-obvious logic

## Wire protocol impact

- [ ] No wire change
- [ ] Wire change with version negotiation (peer fallback tested)
- [ ] Wire change that breaks compatibility (documented in migration notes)
